newsitem.title: USA: Imperial Credit raises qtly payout.
newsitem.headline: Imperial Credit raises qtly payout.

text.p: SANTA ANA HEIGHTS, Calif., Sept 18 (Reuter) Imperial Credit Mortgage Holdings Inc Wednesday said it raised its quarterly dividend by 16 percent to $0.52 a share, payable October 15 to shareholders of record on September 30.

In addition, the company said it intends to declare and pay a special dividend payable to stockholders of record on November 15. The special dividend will be used to distribute the excess taxable income not previously distributed by the company as dividends, in order to comply with the REIT rules.
